issues.desc: background.md Key Insights section and CHK-003 context use "A4" and "a2prime" without inline definition. A4 = Lattice-Reflection-Loop arm (pre-reg §1 table) and a2prime = its naive-retry code alias. The pre-reg citation appears in the first sentence of the Trigger Event, so a careful reader can follow it, but a standalone first-read requires a cross-doc hop to understand these terms.
